comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AVGO disclose specific quantitative exposures related to lease liabilities within the context of VIEs or specific lease obligations, though the nature of the exposure differs. MU reports $680 million in total financial lease liabilities and right-of-use assets associated with Lease SPEs (special purpose entities), which are variable interest entities where MU is not the primary beneficiary. In contrast, AVGO reports $192 million of obligations related specifically to 'restructured leases' included in its short-term and long-term lease liabilities as of November 3, 2024. While MU's figure represents the full balance sheet exposure to its third-party lease SPEs, AVGO's figure isolates a subset of liabilities (restructured) within its broader lease obligations, highlighting different granularity and drivers (SPE financing vs. restructuring) of lease liability exposure.
